verdict.rationale: Notion's flexible databases/boards let teams build kanban-style trackers and some teams use it instead of Jira for workflow tracking, but community evidence notes it hits limits as a dedicated issue/project tracker requiring manual maintenance, and there's no evidence of purpose-built agile features like sprint backlogs, burndown charts, or story-point tracking. missing for 10: dedicated sprint/agile templates, backlog/burndown/velocity tooling, first-party docs on agile workflows.
